description: Issue IDs from beads (claim.IssueID, picked.ID) are used unsanitized in filepath.Join for .sdp/evidence, .sdp/runs, and .sdp/pr-body paths. If an attacker controls beads data (e.g. via malicious commit), issueID containing '../' or path separators could cause read/write outside .sdp. close_reason: Fixed: internal/safeid.ValidateIssueID added; swarm-worker and autonomy-worker validate issueID before path construction. Commit 60e9554.
